title: Three Nights and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（人与自我·做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（人与自我·做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：guard　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 guard 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the keeper ① posted a guard that no worker in the yard would have described, and he said the posting was the whole of the night. The ② guard, meaning the watchman himself and not the dog, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; a guard, he said, is the only thing in a yard that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ guard in that yard had the same short lamp beside him, and the ④ guard at the far gate, meaning the one they kept for the children to watch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A guard, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the keeper said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the guard was the whole of the matter, meaning the watch and not the watchman. The ⑥ guard, meaning the watch and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; guard, he said, is either something you post or the only word that means both a watchman and a watch. He said the watch is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ guard had become a line in a roster, and the roster had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ guard of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in November, was one yard and three nights of describing; guard, he said, is either the one at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ guard I remember is the one described in the roster, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the yard. A ⑩ guard, my mother said in 1974, is the only one that improves by being described; every guard, he said, is a watch that has agreed to look like a watchman. He said the watch was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 卫兵；看守（指院子里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 卫兵；看守（指那个人本人，与狗相对）
C. 固定搭配：post a guard 布置一名卫兵
D. n. 卫兵（指留给孩子们看着的那一位）
E. n. 警戒（抽象总称，指一处院子的守卫之事）
F. n. 卫兵（指值班表上写到、被记下的那一位）
G. n. 守卫；防护装置（指一件事里人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 防护（抽象总称，指人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: posted a guard that no worker in the yard would have described
The guard, meaning the watchman himself and not the dog
the guard at the far gate
the guard was the whole of the matter
the guard had become a line in a roster
The guard of the whole thing
A guard, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: post a guard 意为“布置一名卫兵”，1965 年那位看守人布置了院子里没有一位工人肯描述的一名卫兵。
guard 意为“卫兵、看守”，指那个人本人而不是狗，他经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
guard 意为“卫兵、看守”，指院子里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一盏矮矮的灯。
guard 意为“卫兵”，指最远那道门口留给孩子们看着的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
guard 意为“守卫、防护装置”，指一件事里人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这道防护就是那件事的全部。
guard 意为“防护”，指人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西而不是那名卫兵，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
guard 意为“卫兵”，指值班表上写到、被记下的那一位，到 1970 年这一位成了表上的一行。
guard 意为“警戒”，看守人十一月写道，整件事的守卫之事是一处院子和三个夜晚的描述。
guard 意为“卫兵”，我记得的是值班表上描述过的那一位，1972 年换岗了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一位。
guard 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，一名卫兵是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的看守。
